_about: Jacques Saurin (1677-1730), Huguenot preacher to the French church at The Hague: the standard English Sermons, eight volumes by three translators (Robert Robinson, vols. I-V; Henry Hunter, vol. VI; Joseph Sutcliffe, vols. VII-VIII), in the London printing of 1812-1813 by R. Edwards (Princeton copies). Vols. I and III-V are the fifth edition, vol. VI the fifth, vol. VII the second. Vol. II is the Schenectady reprint of the second London edition (1813), because Internet Archive returned HTTP 500 for the London copy's text. Volume numbers and translators read off each title page; vol. VIII's translator is not claimed (its title page is not in the OCR). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
